_comment: The Season: chapter names (shown when a chapter starts and on the truck screen), the finale boss (chapter 10's milestone boss, or the last chapter's for other run lengths) and the victory payout. Edit freely; a run longer than this list reuses the last names.

chapters.name: First Shift
chapters.flavor: Learn the ropes. The bosses are still sizing you up.

chapters.name: Overtime
chapters.flavor: The haul gets heavier and the halls get louder.

chapters.name: Deep Stacks
chapters.flavor: Deeper floors, nastier things living in them.

chapters.name: Hazard Pay
chapters.flavor: Everything bites harder - and pays better.

chapters.name: Night Shift
chapters.flavor: The monsters don't sleep. Neither do you.

chapters.name: Restructuring
chapters.flavor: Old tricks stop working. New ones show up.

chapters.name: Final Notice
chapters.flavor: One chapter left after this. Don't drop anything.

chapters.name: Liquidation
chapters.flavor: The finale waits at the end of this chapter.

endless.name: Endless
endless.flavor: No finish line now. How deep can the team go?
